possible_explanations.statement: The Belalie‑Davenport line outage notice [c1] may have reduced inter-regional transfer capability or invoked constraints limiting imports into SA, which might have allowed higher-priced local offers to set the RRP.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain constraint binding logs and marginal values for the invoked constraint set S‑DVBL_BC‑2CP, and time series of interconnector transfer limits and realised flows around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: Local generator output reductions or rebids might have reduced available low‑cost supply around the peak and could have allowed higher offers to set the price.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain participant rebid/offer stacks and confirmed outage/trip reports for generating units in SA around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z, and compare with SCADA generation readings.

possible_explanations.statement: A coincident tightening of supply relative to demand (dispatch TOTALDEMAND and operational demand) might have contributed to the price extreme.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare available generation offers, interconnector capability, and five‑minute TOTALDEMAND time series versus operational demand to see whether residual demand left only high‑priced offers at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z.
